subject.title: refactor(qa): finish Matrix QA Lab ownership

question: After https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/103604 is accepted, should an authorized repository owner approve head `8f79563535b19c3c87a9c22f41b6ae1a099cdc1a` to remove the temporary `@openclaw/qa-matrix` workspace package and lockfile importer?
rationale: The code review found no remaining patch defect, but dependency-graph authorization and stacked merge ordering are repository trust decisions that automation cannot grant.

options.title: Approve after prerequisite
options.body: Land or otherwise confirm the prerequisite, verify the final combined diff, then authorize the exact-head package and lockfile removal.

options.title: Retain the compatibility package
options.body: Keep the temporary plugin and private facade until maintainers identify and migrate any additional source-checkout consumers.

options.title: Restack and re-review
options.body: Pause this PR if the prerequisite changes materially, then rebase the cleanup and repeat exact-head package and behavior verification.

recommendation.title: Approve after prerequisite
recommendation.body: Land or otherwise confirm the prerequisite, verify the final combined diff, then authorize the exact-head package and lockfile removal.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work directly owns bundled-plugin dependency localization and packaging boundaries affected by this deletion.
